changelog:
- Initial release of the Davis-Bacon & Prevailing Wage Compliance skill.
- Provides guidance on federal and state prevailing wage laws, including the Davis-Bacon Act and Related Acts.
- Supports wage determination lookup, certified payroll preparation, and compliance for federal and federally-assisted construction projects.
- Includes checklists for audit preparation, summaries of common violations and penalties, and state-by-state prevailing wage references.
- Covers requirements for wage classification/conformance, fringe benefits, apprenticeship, and IRA/IIJA clean energy projects.
- Designed to integrate with contract review, project management, payroll, and bid estimation tools.
